title: Kim Chiu undergoing therapy, fears for safety amid legal battle with sis Lakam

blocks.text: Kim Chiu admitted that she has been struggling emotionally and has sought professional help as she continues to deal with the emotional effects of the legal battle between her and her older sister, Lakambini “Lakam” Chiu. In a vlog uploaded on Sunday, Nov. 22, Kim shared that she was not in a good mental state amid the controversy, revealing that she had become fearful of other people and had to take a step back from work.
